svg.title: Sarno OpenMP speedup and MPI comparison
svg.desc: Measured OpenMP solver and application speedup at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 threads with one MPI process; historical MPI solver reference at matching core counts through 32. Logarithmic axes. Each sweep uses its own one-core baseline; single observations, no confidence intervals.

g.text: MPI solver · matching core counts only
Exclusive node · same executable, native forcing and six-hour workload
Separate solver baselines: OpenMP 10.927 s; MPI 10.562 s
One observation per point; no uncertainty bars. MPI and OpenMP use the same active core counts.
